Five areas of expertise serving our islands

Water networks

We lay and renew drinking water supply and distribution networks, wastewater and stormwater networks, with the associated household connections, ancillary structures and road reinstatement.

  • Drinking water supply and distribution
  • Wastewater networks
  • Stormwater networks
  • Connections and meter boxes
  • Ancillary structures
  • Pressure testing and commissioning
Dedicated equipmentPipe lasers, optical levels, utility detectors, dewatering pumps, 6 to 16 t excavators.
Recent projectsCornet water supply and sanitation, Petit-Canal (€6.3m). See this trade's projects

Roads and asphalt

Our in-house asphalt crew handles milling, paving with wide or narrow pavers and compaction. We work at night when traffic requires it, on main roads and local streets alike.

  • Milling
  • Full-width and strip paving
  • Compaction
  • Tack coats
  • Night work
  • Car parks and roadways
Dedicated equipment2 XCMG milling machines (1.00 and 1.50 m), 2 XCMG pavers (0.50 to 7.50 m), 5 rollers, 2,000 L emulsion sprayer.
Recent projectsRue de Hollande, Friar's Bay, Rue Colombier and Froston in Saint-Martin. See this trade's projects

Utilities and earthworks

Roads and utilities, earthworks, pavements, verges, stormwater networks: we develop and secure public spaces with local authorities and developers.

  • Earthworks
  • Roads and pavements
  • Concrete verges
  • Stormwater drainage
  • Road user safety
  • Urban development
Dedicated equipment8 mini excavators, 6 to 15 t excavators, 2 wheeled excavators 16 t, 2 backhoe loaders, 7 dump trucks.
Recent projectsDevelopments in Vieux-Fort and Capesterre-Belle-Eau for the Department. See this trade's projects

Special works

In a seismic zone, ground conditions often call for special solutions. We build micropiles, soil-nailed walls, retaining structures, shotcrete and seismic reinforcement of existing buildings, as well as slope stabilisation.

  • Micropiles
  • Soil-nailed walls
  • Retaining walls
  • Shotcrete
  • Seismic reinforcement
  • Slope stabilisation
Dedicated equipmentComacchio MC8 HT and XCMG XLS4 rigs, Marini drilling units, grouting plant, shotcrete units, compressors up to 24 m³.
Recent projects384 micropiles at the Bergevin residence, soil-nailed wall in Vieux-Fort, micropiles in Le Gosier. See this trade's projects

Building and civil engineering

Heavy rehabilitation, reconstruction, structural work and reinforced concrete: we work on public facilities, multi-unit housing and industrial buildings, coordinating all trades.

  • Structural work
  • Reinforced concrete
  • Heavy rehabilitation
  • Reconstruction
  • All trades
  • Compliance upgrades
Dedicated equipmentXCMG XS5008D concrete pump, 14 m telehandlers, full power tool set.
